notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted API for quick POC then moving to Dedicated/VPC for production. Key players: PM (Claire Huang), Head of Infra (Samir Kaur), Security lead (Tom Bishop).

Call notes / voice snippets: - 02/12 intro: PM wants in-app assistant + better semantic search, currently using a mix of Elastic + small LLM for prompts. 'If we can't guarantee 200ms p95 we won't replace current system' (Claire). - 02/20 demo: Devs liked streaming and embeddings; wanted examples of autoscaling and bursts for seasonal traffic. - 02/25 POC kickoff: hosted POC for 2 weeks (chat + embeddings). Devs instrumenting quality tests (precision/recall on search). - 03/01 security questionnaire: heavy focus on Dedicated/VPC controls, audit log format, retention, SSO metadata. Security asks: SOC2 evidence, SAML metadata, KMS integration options, exportable audit logs >=365d. - 03/03 pricing call: asked for committed capacity quote, reserved GPU tiers, burst pricing, and migration path from hosted to dedicated.

Technical requirements / constraints: - Workloads: low-latency chat (customer-facing), embeddings for semantic search at query volumes ~100-200 qps peak, reranking batch jobs at night. - Latency target: p95 <= 200ms for chat generation (short prompts, streaming allowed). - Throughput: sustained 80-120 req/s for embeddings during business hours; batch embedding jobs (10k items) overnight. - Model preferences: open models (Llama2 / Falcon variants), 8-bit quantized where quality acceptable; want verified performance profiles. - Routing/fallback: primary US-east region, fallback to eu-west for EU customers; automatic fallback to lower-cost model variant when capacity constrained. - Cost sensitivity: looking for ~30-40% reduction vs current managed vendor for token costs at scale.

Security / compliance specifics: - SOC2: currently have SOC2 Type I, seeking vendors with SOC2 Type II evidence or roadmap to provide control attestations. - SSO/SAML required for console access and admin roles; IdP is Okta. - KMS: want customer-managed keys for encryption at rest. - Audit logging: must be exportable in JSON/CSV, retention minimum 365 days; retention controls configurable per-tenant. - Data residency: EU customers' data must remain in eu-west1 for embeddings and logs.

POC & Eval criteria: - POC success = chat latency p95 <=200ms, embeddings recall >=0.82 on our eval set, token cost <= target. - Milestones: (1) Hosted POC (2 weeks) with sample traffic; (2) Security workshop to map Dedicated/VPC controls; (3) Dedicated pricing & contract draft; (4) pilot Dedicated with reserved capacity for 3 months.

Stated quotes / color: - Product: "Need a clear migration path from hosted to private; don't want surprises in cost or performance." - Infra: "Give us KMS diagram + SSO flows and audit log examples."

Internal notes (AE): keep follow-ups short and technical. Attach security deck and pricing proposal shared 03/03.
